Name: Elle's Seasonal Vanilla Buildings
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]

This mod uses the same kinds of seasonal features used in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Seasonal Buildings[/url] mod, but for your vanilla farm buildings!

Includes:
- Seasonal overlays for farm buildings
     - Grass in spring and summer
     - Leaves in fall
     - Icicles in winter
- Choice between snow or ice-covered buildings in winter
- Seasonal tones for farm buildings, fences, shipping bins, and the mailbox
     - More green in summer
     - More red in fall
     - Less saturated in winter
- Hanging flower pot on farmhouse
- Holiday decor on farmhouse
- Snow and misc winter changes for the buildings in town
- Each type of overlay can be globally toggled, and each individual farm building can be toggled

The changes made by the [color=#f9cb9c]Winter Town Changes[/color] option are as follows:
- Snow added to all building roofs in town
- Misc snow tiles (on objects, etc) are recolored to match better
- The movie theatre's purple tiles and Linus's tent are recolored to be icy blue

This feature was made with vanilla maps in mind, and this mod currently does not include dependencies to make it compatible with map recolors.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. Unzip/extract the[b][color=#f6b26b] [CP] Elle's Seasonal [b][color=#f6b26b]Vanilla [/color][/b]Buildings[/color][/b] folder into your [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] folder.
4. (Optional) Run the game once with SMAPI to generate a [b]config.json[/b], then close.
5. (Optional) Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and use the images in the "References" folder to configure the mod to your liking.
6. Run the game using SMAPI to play!

Reference images are included in a [b]References [/b]folder to use with the config.json.

The options in the config are true/false settings. The exception is [color=#f9cb9c]Winter Roofs[/color], which can be set to "[font=Courier New]Snow[/font]" and "[font=Courier New]Ice[/font]" (or "[font=Courier New]False[/font]" to disable). 

To uninstall, delete the [CP] Elle's Seasonal Vanilla Buildings folder.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]﻿
